newsitem.title: USA: Neurobiological's CRF fails Phase II trial.
newsitem.headline: Neurobiological's CRF fails Phase II trial.

text.p: Neurobiological Technologies Inc said its Phase II clinical trials of Corticotropin-Releasing Factor (CRF) in patients with rheumatoid arthritis showed no statistical difference between patients treated with CRF and those treated with placebos.
The company said the trial, which involved 113 patients, did not confirm an earlier clinical trial and does not support continued developmentof CRF for rheumatoid arthritis.
The company will continue to develop CRF for brain edema -- or swelling of the brain -- it said. The company also said it plans a Phase II clinical trial for CRF to treat brain edema this year.
